controlled_variable: target unmarked-pavement excursion 60.96 m versus 61.06 m
sampled_distance_rule: Sum observed ego-center XY steps only between consecutive frames with the full ego body on authored right shoulder; adjacent boundary steps give a conservative upper uncertainty. An unfinished exit is incomplete, never within the limit. The sampled relation is a measurement diagnostic and needs original video review before a statutory finding.
synthetic_cpu_boundary_finding: At 20 Hz, the 61.06 m primary request measures over 60.96 m; the 60.96 m primary request remains ambiguous after boundary uncertainty. The stop variant has no observed exit. These are synthetic diagnostics, not original Native facts.
fixed_controls: authored road 212 and unmarked right shoulder
original_measurements_required: generated Native shoulder and lane readback
observed ego body entrance and exit from unmarked pavement
distance integrated between actual boundary crossings with uncertainty
pavement free of obstructions and parked vehicles
